task: Observe the distinct zipper repairs demonstrated on bags and a garment. Separate visible actions from spoken explanations. Infer only tentative principles about choosing a repair from the observed problem; do not invent hidden diagnoses or claim professional verification.

events.action: Operating zipper on black backpack left pocket
events.observed_result: Zipper slider moves along teeth and pocket opens and closes
events.visible_evidence: Two hands contacting a black backpack on a wooden table, pulling a corded zipper pull on the left front pocket

events.action: Displaying small pull component next to bare slider on right pocket
events.observed_result: Right pocket slider is visible without attached pull while a small metal and cord piece is held in fingers nearby
uncertainties: Whether the held piece is original or replacement is unknown
events.visible_evidence: Close-up of black backpack with two front zippered pockets, left pocket with pull attached, right pocket slider bare, fingers holding a small zipper pull

events.action: Cutting dark flexible material with scissors
events.observed_result: A strip is separated from the larger piece of dark material
uncertainties: Material type and intended use of cut strip are unknown
events.visible_evidence: Left hand holding folded dark gray material, right hand operating large scissors with light handles to cut along edge

events.action: Threading and knotting a pull through right pocket slider
events.observed_result: A thin strip is looped through the slider hole and secured with a knot, hanging as a pull
events.visible_evidence: Hands feeding a thin light then dark strip through the metal slider on the black backpack right pocket and manipulating it into a knot

events.observed_result: Zipper opens and closes by the new pull; excess length is cut off
events.visible_evidence: Hand pulling the newly attached strip to move the slider, then using scissors to trim the end near the knot

events.action: Hand sewing along zipper area of tan bag
events.observed_result: Needle and thread pass repeatedly through the edge of the tan bag near the zipper tape
uncertainties: Stitch type and condition being addressed are unknown
events.visible_evidence: Hands holding a tan duffle-style bag open, manipulating a needle with light-colored thread along the zipper edge, pulling thread through

events.action: Manipulating metal zipper slider on gray garment
events.observed_result: Slider moves down the teeth and fabric edges are aligned by hand
events.visible_evidence: Fingers contacting a silver metal zipper on light gray quilted fabric, moving the slider and adjusting the two sides of the zipper tape

events.action: Sewing gray garment with electric sewing machine
events.observed_result: Fabric feeds under the needle while stitching occurs
uncertainties: Exact seam location relative to zipper is unknown
events.visible_evidence: Person in white shirt guiding light gray fabric under the needle of a white sewing machine on a wooden table, hands repositioning fabric during sewing

events.observed_result: loose thread ends are cut from the fabric near the zipper
events.visible_evidence: Hands holding gray fabric next to sewing machine, using small scissors to snip threads

events.observed_result: Zipper moves from bottom to top and top to bottom, closing and opening the front
events.visible_evidence: Person holding up a light gray quilted zip-front jacket and pulling the zipper slider up and down with one hand
